caption: The drawing in grayscale depicts a kitchen utensil or mold consisting of a horizontal rectangular metal frame with three round, concave depressions spaced evenly along its length. Attached to the left side of the frame is a cylindrical handle with a wider, rounded grip, suggestive of wood texture. Below the frame and aligned with each depression are three conical forms extending downward, indicating that the metal frame is designed to hold or shape soft materials. Supporting the frame are two downward-curving metal legs, one positioned near the center and another at the right end, providing stability for the utensil to stand above a surface. The entire drawing is rendered with attention to shading and texture, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and light in color, and the drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border. In the lower left corner, there is handwritten text “Filippo Paroca.”
title: Egg Roaster
